newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: SCK wins Cambodian construction contract.
newsitem.headline: SCK wins Cambodian construction contract.

text.p: Malaysia's Shanghai Chong Kee Bhd (SCK) said on Thursday it has agreed to undertake a $45 million turnkey construction contract in Cambodia.

SCK said in a statement that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Shanghai Chong Kee Construction Sdn Bhd, has entered into an agreement with HSL Organisation Group of Cambodia to construct a complex and redevelop the existing Central Market and its surrounding areas in Phnom Penh.
It said the immediate funds required for the project will be sourced internally though it is expected that a project finance loan or a fund raising exercise may be put in place in the near future.

SCK also said that another wholly-owned unit, Gamecorp Sdn Bhd, after having entered into a Deed of Appointment with a Cambodian company, will be proceeding with the establishment of a casino operations in Phnom Penh.
Gamecorp has been granted management rights for an initial period of 10 years, with an option for a further 10-year period.
